newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Knoxville, Tenn.

text.p: General Obligation Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1997 A
General Obligation Refunding Bonds, Series 1997 A

Sealed bids will be received by the City of Knoxville, Tennessee (the City'') at the office of the Mayor, City/County Building, 400 Main Avenue, Room 691, Knoxville, Tennessee 37902 until 11:00 a.m., EDT on:

Such bids will be publicly opened and read at such time and place on said day for the purchase of all, but not less than all, of the City's $23,340,000 General Obligation Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1997 A and General

The sale on April 29, 1997 may be postponed upon no less than twenty-four hours notice given prior to the time bids are to be received and as communicated via the Munifacts News Wire upon forty-eight hours notice. The Bonds will be dated May 1, 1997 and will mature on May 1, in the years 1998 through 2017 inclusive. The Bonds are callable on May 1, 2005 and thereafter as provided in the Detailed Official Notice of Sale. No bid will be considered for the Bonds for less than ninety-eight and one-half percent (98.5%) of par plus accrued interest or more than one hundred and two percent (102%) of par plus accrued interest, and the rate or rates bid of the Bonds shall not exceed seven percent (7%) per annum, and the yield to the call must exceed the yield to maturity on all callable bonds. The principal amount of the Bonds may be reduced, and the General Obligation Refunding Bonds, Series 1997 A may not be issued, all as described in the Detailed Official Notice of Sale. Unless all the bids for the Bonds are rejected, the Bonds will be awarded by the Mayor to the bidder whose bid complies with the Detailed Official Notice of Sale and results in the lowest true interest rate on the Bonds. One bond certificate for each maturity will be issued to and registered in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York and immobilized in its custody at the expense of the City. The approving opinion of Bass, Berry & Sims PLC, Knoxville/Nashville, Tennessee, will be furnished at the expense of the City. Additional information, including the Preliminary Official Statement, deemed in final form, Bid Form, and the Detailed Official Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the

undersigned at the City/County Building, 400 Main Avenue, Room 691, Knoxville, Tennessee 37902 or PFM/Culver-Dyer Securities, Inc., Financial Advisor, 607 Market Street, Suite 400, Knoxville, Tennessee 37902, telephone (423) 524- 4656.
